flags.title: Sector tailwind

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value" (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the sustainable net profit (PAT) business margin is around 4% plus.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo..." opportunities.point: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during the IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Despite elevated gold prices, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments. We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted an increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers and retailers as they expand footprints and optimize inventory.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company's existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo..." opportunities.point: The current capacity utilization of the existing factory is around 65%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our present capacity is around 65%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The Marol factory is expected to start in a month or so, and the Jaipur factory should start around September or October.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)
